items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the R-universality criterion for the absolutely simple algebras of type E6 (author prop at source lines 782-790), stated as strong innerness or as splitting over an imaginary quadratic extension. The proof (source lines 792-821) reduces the criterion to a single Tits algebra via the prime-order centre, then uses the classification of type E6 forms to decide which indices are strongly inner, and finally handles the outer forms over the quadratic splitting extension (proof lines 793-820). The case analysis driven by the classification is the content of the proof. H2.
